propositions: configure_logging() sets propagate=False on the shared 'rebar' logger globally, which prevents pytest caplog from capturing subsequent log records from rebar.* loggers in any test phase that runs after the call
caplog assertions on rebar.* loggers fail silently when they follow a configure_logging() call in execution order, returning empty record lists instead of expected matches
the failure is intermittent and order-dependent across test runs due to nondeterministic worker assignment in parallel test execution, making it difficult to detect without deterministic reproduction
removing propagate=False from configure_logging() restores caplog capture while preserving the existing marker-guarded handler that prevents double-logging through uvicorn
the propagate mutation must be removed or conditionally applied to allow caplog to function correctly in all tests regardless of execution order
